# 09 — Public performance and polish: lazy admin, WebP images, fonts, caching, README

Today every visitor to the booking site downloads the whole admin app: one 638 kB JS bundle (169 kB gzip)
because `src/App.jsx` imports every `/admin*` page statically. The home page ships a 3763x1681 px,
111 kB PNG logo that renders 160 px wide and a 200 kB JPEG hero; Google Fonts is pulled through a CSS `@import`
that blocks rendering; the tab title is `tonda-reservation` with no description; hashed assets are not cached
long-term; the Events and Offsite forms hide the "valid phone" message behind "Something went wrong" and allow past
dates; the README is the Vite template. After this package admin code loads only on `/admin*`, images are WebP at
the size they are shown, fonts load via preconnect + `<link>`, `/assets/*` is cached for a year, and the README and
CLAUDE.md describe the repo as it is. No database change.

Branch: `build/09-public-perf-and-polish`
Brainstormed: 2026-10-17. Decisions made by Claude under Perng's 2026-10-17 "work autonomously" instruction; see docs/build/2026-10-17-audit-plan.md
Depends on: nothing. Independent of 05-08 (owns `App.jsx`, `index.html`, `index.css`, `Home.jsx`, `Navbar.jsx`, `Events.jsx`, `Offsite.jsx`, `vercel.json`, `README.md`, `src/assets/*`, `CLAUDE.md`).

---

## Plan discrepancies

- Plan: "hero is at most 1600 px wide". `reservations-hero.jpg` is **1400x1400** (square), so there is no downscale;
  it is converted at its own size and `width`/`height` are 1400/1400.
- Plan: "logo resized to 2x its largest rendered size". The PNG is 3763x1681 (ratio 2.24). Rendered sizes: `Home.jsx:62` `w-40`
  (160 px wide, about 71 px high), `Navbar.jsx:34` `h-8` (32 px high, about 72 wide), `Login.jsx:35` `h-10` (40 high, about 90 wide).
  Largest is Home at 160 px wide, so the WebP is **320 px wide (320x143)**.
- `Login.jsx` imports `../../assets/Logo_2.png` and is owned by package 07, so `Logo_2.png` **stays in `src/assets/`**; the WebP is added
  alongside and only `Home.jsx` and `Navbar.jsx` switch to it. `reservations-hero.jpg` is only imported by `Home.jsx` and is deleted.
  Follow-up (not here): once 07 has landed, switch `Login.jsx` to the WebP and delete `Logo_2.png`. Also `Login.jsx:35` has `alt="Round"` on Tonda's logo (07's file).
- CLAUDE.md says lint is "14 problems (10 errors / 4 warnings)". Measured on main `00a0bf6` it is **16 (11 / 5)**. The number written by T9 must be
  measured on the branch after rebasing on the latest main, not copied from here.
- The new invariant grep `toISOString\(\)\.split` has two live hits until packages 05 and 06 merge: `src/pages/Reservations.jsx:291` (05) and
  `src/pages/ManageBooking.jsx:93` (06). Those are expected and are not failures of this package; any other hit is.
- `fetchpriority` is written `fetchPriority` in React 19 JSX.

## Decisions

| Question | Chosen | Rejected | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Admin code splitting | `React.lazy` for every `/admin*` page (Dashboard, Tables, Bookings, SlotRules, Customers, AdminFeedback, Login, Settings, Experiences) inside one `Suspense` around `<Routes>` | Lazy public pages too; route-level `manualChunks` | Plan: "`React.lazy` for every `/admin*` page plus `Suspense`" |
| Fonts | Remove the `@import url(https://fonts.googleapis.com...)` from `index.css`; `preconnect` x2 + `<link rel="stylesheet">` in `index.html` | Self-hosting fonts | Plan |
| Title / description | Real `<title>` and `<meta name="description">` in `index.html` | Per-route titles | Plan |
| Image format | WebP via sharp, run once, dev-only (not a project dependency); output committed | `vite-imagetools`, runtime conversion | Plan: "sharp, run once, dev-only" |
| Logo | 320 px wide WebP; `Logo_2.png` kept for `Login.jsx` (07's file) | Deleting the PNG; touching Login | File ownership |
| Hero | WebP at source size (1400x1400), `width`/`height`, `fetchPriority="high"`, `decoding="async"` | Lazy hero | Plan |
| Cache header | `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` on `/assets/(.*)` in `vercel.json` | Caching HTML | Plan; Vite hashes everything in `/assets` |
| Events/Offsite | Validate phone with `isValidPhone(normalisePhone(...))` before submitting and show `Please enter a valid phone number.` (same as `Reservations.jsx:452-453`); `min={getLocalToday()}` on the date input | Parsing the thrown error message | `findOrCreateCustomer` moves to an RPC in 06, so its error text is not a stable contract |
| README / CLAUDE.md | Real README (keep the `public_holidays` re-seed section verbatim); CLAUDE.md invariant greps gain `toISOString\(\)\.split`, lint baseline updated | — | Plan |

### T1 — Record the "before"
**Do:** On a clean checkout of the branch run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`. Write down (for the PR body, not a file): the entry chunk line
`dist/assets/index-*.js` size and gzip size, the `Logo_2-*.png` and `reservations-hero-*.jpg` sizes, and the lint summary line.
On main `00a0bf6` they were: JS 638.49 kB / 169.20 kB gzip, logo PNG 111.02 kB, hero JPG 200.57 kB, lint 16 problems (11 errors, 5 warnings).
**Verify:** the numbers are recorded; `git status --short` is clean.

### T2 — Convert the images (one-off, sharp in a temp dir)
**Do:** Do not add sharp to the repo. From a temp directory outside the project (`mkdir`/`cd` to your scratch dir): `npm init -y`, `npm i sharp`, then run a one-off node script
(or `npx sharp-cli` if you prefer) that writes into the project's `src/assets/`:
`Logo_2.png` -> `Logo_2.webp` with `resize({ width: 320 })` and `webp({ quality: 90, alphaQuality: 100 })` (the logo has alpha; expect about 21 kB, 320x143);
`reservations-hero.jpg` -> `reservations-hero.webp` with `resize({ width: 1600, withoutEnlargement: true })` and `webp({ quality: 75 })` (source is 1400x1400 so no resize happens; expect about 111 kB).
Delete `src/assets/reservations-hero.jpg` (`git rm`). Leave `Logo_2.png` in place. Check dimensions with `sharp(file).metadata()` and open both WebPs to eyeball them (logo edges clean on a dark background, hero not banded).
**Verify:** `ls -l src/assets` shows `Logo_2.png`, `Logo_2.webp` (< 30 kB), `reservations-hero.webp` (< 130 kB), no `.jpg`; `git status --short` shows no change to `package.json` or `package-lock.json`.

### T5 — Lazy-load the admin
**Do:** `src/App.jsx`: import `{ lazy, Suspense }` from `react`; replace the static imports of `Dashboard`, `Tables`, `Bookings`, `SlotRules`, `Customers`, `AdminFeedback` (`./pages/admin/Feedback`), `Login`, `Settings`, `Experiences` with
`const Dashboard = lazy(() => import('./pages/admin/Dashboard'))` etc. (all default exports; keep the exact variable names so the `<Route>` elements are unchanged). Keep static imports for public pages, `Navbar`, `Footer`, `RequireAuth`, `NewBookingAlert`.
Wrap `<Routes>...</Routes>` in `<Suspense fallback={<Loading />}>` with `import { Loading } from './components/admin/States'`.

### T6 — Long-term cache for hashed assets
**Do:** `vercel.json`: add a second object to `headers` after the existing one: `{ "source": "/assets/(.*)", "headers": [{ "key": "Cache-Control", "value": "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" }] }`. Keep the rewrite and the `X-Robots-Tag` entry unchanged; keep the file's 2-space JSON style.
**Verify:** `node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('vercel.json','utf8'))"` exits 0; `grep -c "immutable" vercel.json` = 1. (After deploy: `curl -sI <preview>/assets/<hashed-file>` shows the header; owner checks.)

**Do:** In `Events.jsx` and `Offsite.jsx`: change the import to `import { findOrCreateCustomer, isValidPhone, normalisePhone } from '../supabaseCustomers'` (first confirm both are still exported: `grep -n "export function normalisePhone\|export function isValidPhone" src/supabaseCustomers.js`; if package 06 removed either, stop and report). Add `min={getLocalToday()}` to the date input (`Events.jsx:159` `name="event_date"`, and the matching `event_date` input in `Offsite.jsx`; locate it with `grep -n 'name="event_date"' src/pages/Offsite.jsx`). Do not change the insert payloads, the `settings` read, or the generic catch message.
